name: momentum-stop-sizing-v1
description: Stop-sizing sweep for the TSM stocks sleeve (OPEN.md P2: the same entry-anchored 4% is ~0.8 sigma of a p90 263h hold — 3 of 6 live closes were STOP_LOSS at avg -$660). Everything except the hard-stop axis is FROZEN to experiments/momentum-stocks-v1.json: same universe/costs/window/folds and the same acceptance gates including minExcessReturnVsBench 0 (full-exposure sleeve; NOT relaxed — note that gate now BINDS here, unlike the pre-gate momentum-stocks-v1 artifact). All 4 candidates carry the production incumbent knobs (cadence 60, slot 0.5, entry 5/exit -2, maxLongs 4, tsmTrail k3/78/2-8, sharpeGate 30d/0, peakHalfLifeDays 30) and differ ONLY in the hard stop: incumbent (ABSENT hardStop = ledger fixed 4%), no-stop (the live vol TRAIL remains active on every candidate, so this tests whether the entry-anchored 4% adds protection or only amputates trends ON TOP of the trail), and two vol-scaled entry-anchored variants (kSigma 3 clamp 2..8 = entry-anchored twin of the live trail; kSigma 4 clamp 3..12 = wider, sized for the sleeve's multi-week horizon) — EXACT production trailPctFromVol formula, sigma over 78 5m RTH bars = 1 trading day. priorUniqueTrials=252: the 251 inventoried legacy v7 hypotheses plus momentum-stocks-v1's single incumbent trial. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates. SCOPE NOTE (honest cost cap): 5m-bar replays are expensive; this manifest carries 4 candidates instead of the meanrev sweep's 5 (vol-k2 dropped, its 2..8% span is mostly covered between the trail and vol-k3) — the smaller sweep is declared here BEFORE running, not trimmed after seeing results.
